subject: Outstanding balance — payment trajectory & VAT evidence (Seneca Partners)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Seneca Partners Finance <finance@senecapartners.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-15T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Outstanding balance and VAT documentation request — INV-2027-09

Hi Emily / Seneca finance team,

We wanted to follow up on invoice INV-2027-09 (Due 2027-05-31, now 45 days past due) for $98,360 USD. We have not yet received remittance or VAT documentation needed for our records. To move this forward we need: 

- confirmation of the payment trajectory (dates and amounts)
- copy of Seneca's VAT registration and any local withholding tax (WHT) certificate if you will be applying a gross-up or withholding
- remittance advice when the payment is sent

I attached the invoice (INV-2027-09-seneca.pdf) for reference.

Given the age and size of the balance, we need a clear payment plan by end of day Thursday (2027-07-17). If you need to split the payment, outline the dates and amounts and we will evaluate internally. If we don't have a firm plan, we will escalate to our credit committee and consider service suspension per our terms — we want to avoid that.

Next steps I propose: send bank remittance for any first tranche and VAT evidence to accounts@redwood.com. We can accept a two-tranche schedule (50/50) as a short-term accommodation if you can confirm the first payment within 5 business days.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachment: INV-2027-09-seneca.pdf

From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@senecapartners.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@senecapartners.com>
Date: 2027-07-16T14:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance and VAT documentation request — INV-2027-09

Hi Marcus — apologies for the delay. We inherited some unexpected timing issues on AR this month and are working through them.

We can do a split payment to avoid escalation: 50% (USD 49,180) immediately and the remainder within 30 days. I need to confirm exact payment date by COB tomorrow — our Treasury is coordinating the wire.

On VAT: Seneca is registered for VAT in the UK and will provide our VAT certificate. If Redwood needs a full VAT invoice showing your VAT charge breakdown, please confirm (we currently received the PDF you attached but not the VAT breakdown). On WHT: we do not typically withhold on international SaaS, but we will check with legal and attach any certificate if a withholding occurs.

I will send remittance evidence for the first tranche once Treasury initiates the wire. Please confirm the account details and any reference you need on the transfer.

Thanks,
Emily Ross
CFO, Seneca Partners
emily.ross@senecapartners.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-16T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Outstanding balance — proposed handling and risk assessment

Team — forwarding Emily's note. Quick take: acceptable to accept a two-tranche plan conditionally but require: 

1) Up-front remittance evidence for tranche 1 and clear bank reference matching INV-2027-09.
2) VAT registration document + VAT certificate before tranche 1 is reconciled.
3) DocuSign payment agreement (we attach proposed-MAP-Seneca.docx) with dates and late-payment remedy.
4) If WHT is applied, require a copy of the WHT certificate so we can process gross-up or tax crediting.

If they commit to 50% today and deliver docs, we can hold off on service suspension. If they miss tranche 1 or docs, escalate to credit committee and prepare suspension notice draft.

Attachment: proposed-MAP-Seneca.docx

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Credit & Collections
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Seneca Partners Finance <finance@senecapartners.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-17T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance and VAT documentation request — INV-2027-09

Emily — thanks for the quick reply and the proposed split. To finalize we need three items before we mark tranche 1 as "in process":

1) remittance instruction confirmation (bank account and reference) — we prefer the wire include INV-2027-09 as the reference
2) copy of Seneca's VAT certificate (Seneca-VAT-certificate.pdf) uploaded to accounts@redwood.com or attached to this thread
3) confirmation of the tranche 1 amount and expected value date (we need evidence that Treasury has initiated the wire)

For convenience I'm including a payment link and the HubSpot ticket for tracking (HS-54872). We can also execute the attached DocuSign if you prefer a short MAP (mutual action plan). If tranche 1 posts within 3 business days and we have the VAT certificate, we'll pause escalation. If tranche 1 is not posted by 2027-07-22 end of day, we will escalate to the credit committee and consider temporary suspension per our T&Cs.

Payment link: https://payments.redwood.com/pay/SEN-ENT-2027-09
DocuSign (optional): https://docusign.com/link/abc123-seneca-payment-agreement

Please send remittance as soon as Treasury confirms.

Regards,

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@senecapartners.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@senecapartners.com>, Seneca Partners Finance <finance@senecapartners.com>
Date: 2027-07-17T15:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Outstanding balance and VAT documentation request — INV-2027-09

Marcus — quick update: Treasury initiated the first wire this morning for USD 49,180 (50%). Attached is the remittance screenshot (Seneca-remit-20270717.png) and our VAT registration certificate (Seneca-VAT-certificate.pdf). Reference on the wire: INV-2027-09 / SEN-ENT-2027-09.

We will target the remaining 50% on or before 2027-08-16. If anything changes I will notify you immediately — we understand the escalation threshold and appreciate the accommodation.

Emily Ross
CFO, Seneca Partners
Attachment: Seneca-remit-20270717.png, Seneca-VAT-certificate.pdf
